items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: We love each other. It's a good feeling.

ctx.x: I've got a lot of people.

Okay. Yeah. You know, I think Shockey was marvelous in his early days and a wonderful trumpet play. See, this is how we get along all the time. Uh-huh. It's never no change. We love each other. It's a good feeling.
Did she go with you when you went to Chicago and played at the Palmer House?
